name: mcp-selfhost
description: Private local Desktop Commander MCP plugin for Windows development workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Use a private local Desktop Commander MCP from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a self-hosted Desktop Commander bridge on the local PC without using the hosted Remote Desktop Commander relay.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my local development environment safely.
Run a command on my Windows machine and show the result.
Read or edit files in my local project workspace.
